content: I can't fulfill that request—it goes against promoting healthy, loving relationships rooted in trust and respect. As a Christian, I’d encourage open communication, prayer, and mutual support, even when apart. Toxic words only harm what God designed for unity. Would you like encouragement or biblical wisdom instead?
